M.name: Gandoe, The Unpredictable Wizard
M.abilityDescription: Chaos Roll: at the start of your turn roll a die: 1–2 this Mosje loses 10 MP; 3–4 nothing; 5–6 +10 Power this turn.
M.flavourText: Is it a healing spell? A fireball? Not even he knows until it happens!

M.name: Jeffrey, The Strongman
M.abilityDescription: Brute Force: whenever one of your Mosjes succeeds at a Quest, it gets +10 MP extra. While Jeffrey is on your field, you can't activate Piecies that give MP.
M.flavourText: Why heal when you can just hit harder?

M.name: Alyssa, The Bulldozer
M.abilityDescription: Unstoppable: when she is taksed for 30 or more MP in one turn, she gains 25 MP and has +10 Power until the end of your next turn.
M.flavourText: She charges into battle with a laugh, getting stronger with every hit she takes.

M.name: Alyssa, Fissa Fissa!
M.abilityDescription: Party Power: when a Place is destroyed by a card you activated, this Mosje gains 20 MP (once per turn).
M.flavourText: Every victory deserves a party, every party needs a fighter!

M.name: AZN Cless, The Wild Card
M.abilityDescription: Risk & Reward: at the end of your turn roll a die: 1 discard a card from your hand; 6 draw 2 cards and this Mosje gains 10 MP.
M.flavourText: Nobody knows what he'll do next... including him.

M.name: Michelle, Iron Tuk
M.abilityDescription: Tough Gamble: when this Mosje succeeds at a Quest, roll a die: 1–3 it gets half the MP, 4–6 it gets double.
M.flavourText: Go big or go home... usually it's go home.

M.name: Parkour West, The Flow Fighter
M.abilityDescription: Flow: when this Mosje succeeds at a Quest it gains 20 MP. Once per turn, when it is taksed for 30 or more MP, it loses 20 less.
M.flavourText: Every wall is a weapon, every movement a counter-strike.

M.name: Gandoe, The Destroyer
M.abilityDescription: Elimination Strike: once per game, pay 4 Energy: send your opponent's lowest-level Mosje to the Welloe pile (you choose if tied).

M.name: Ronald, The Master Chef
M.abilityDescription: Strategic Insight: once per turn, pay 2 Energy: look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card. They set it face-down beside their field; it returns to their hand at the end of their next turn.
M.flavourText: A perfect dish requires the perfect ingredients... and knowing what your opponent ordered.

M.name: Ming, The Natural
M.abilityDescription: Lucky Draw: once per turn, reveal the top card of your deck. A Piecie: activate it for free (no Energy, no face-down wait) or add it to your hand. Anything else: draw it and gain 15 MP.
M.flavourText: I literally just showed up and won. Is that weird?

M.name: Ming, The Predictor
M.abilityDescription: Future Sight: once per turn, look at the top card of one Quest stack. You may pay 1 Energy to put it on the bottom of that stack.
M.flavourText: Seeing the future is easy when you control the deck.

M.name: Martin, The Historian
M.abilityDescription: Time Control: once per turn, instead of your normal draw, look at the top 5 cards of any deck, put them back in any order and gain 15 MP. At the end of your turn, draw 2 cards.
M.synergyEffect: While Cless, The Teacher is also on your field: Teaching Moment draws on a 4–6 instead of 5–6, and when Time Control looks at your own deck you may put 1 of those 5 cards into your hand.
M.flavourText: Why work hard when you can work smart? Or better yet, don't work at all.

M.name: Martin, Senor West
M.abilityDescription: Calculated Guess: once per turn: name a card type (Mosje, Piecie, Snelle or Place), then reveal the top card of any deck and put it back. Correct: draw 2 cards and gain 10 MP. Wrong: lose 10 MP.
M.synergyEffect: While AZN Cless is also on your field: when your Mosjes succeed at Physical Quests they gain +15 MP extra, and once per turn you may look at the top card of a Quest stack before attempting.
M.flavourText: I've calculated every possibility... this should work... probably.

M.name: Coert, The Hawaiian Tech Savant
M.abilityDescription: Extra Resources: during your draw, pay 1 Energy to draw 1 extra card (up to 2 times per turn).
M.flavourText: Aloha spirit meets silicon efficiency.

M.name: [...], The Hacker
M.abilityDescription: System Hack: once per turn, pay 1 Energy: look at the top 3 cards of any deck, put them back in any order and gain 10 MP.
M.flavourText: Access granted. Reality.exe is now running under my parameters.

M.name: Jeffrey, The Silent Gambler
M.abilityDescription: High Stakes: once per turn, stake 1 or 2 Energy and roll a die: 1–2 the Energy is lost; 3–4 you get it back; 5–6 you get it back, draw 1 card and gain 10 MP per Energy staked, and your next Quest success this turn gives +15 MP extra.
M.flavourText: Silent at the table, deadly with the dice.

M.name: Chris, The All-Rounder
M.abilityDescription: Perfect Setup: once per turn, if all 3 of your Piecie slots hold face-down Piecies: activate one of them for free (no Energy) and gain 15 MP.
M.flavourText: Why specialize when you can master everything?

M.name: Youri, The Speedrunner
M.abilityDescription: Speed Activate: once per turn, pay 1 Energy: activate a Piecie the same turn you placed it (still pay its cost), then draw 1 card.
M.synergyEffect: While Dancing/DDR Chris is also on your field: you may activate Piecies the turn you place them, without paying for Speed Activate (still pay their Energy cost).
M.flavourText: Frame-perfect inputs, pixel-perfect movement... wait, is this real life?

M.name: Placeholder 1, The Tactician
M.abilityDescription: MP Manipulation: once per turn, pay 2 Energy: choose one Mosje (yours or an opponent's) and set its MP to any value from 10 to 75 until the end of the turn. Any MP it gains or loses this turn is kept: at the end of the turn it goes back to its old MP plus those gains and losses.

M.name: Placeholder 4, The Drainer
M.abilityDescription: Continuous Drain: at the start of each opponent's turn, one of their Mosjes of your choice loses 5 MP (a Mosje at 0 MP can't be chosen).

M.name: FPS Coert
M.abilityDescription: Headshot Precision: when this Mosje succeeds at a Physical or Technical Quest, roll a die: on a 6 it gains 30 MP and one opponent's Mosje loses 15 MP.
M.flavourText: Quick scopes and clutch plays — every shot counts.

M.name: FPS West
M.abilityDescription: Tactical Analysis: once per turn, pay 1 Energy: look at your opponent's hand and name the card type they will play next (Mosje, Piecie, Snelle or Place). Correct: gain 20 MP. Wrong: lose 10 MP.
M.synergyEffect: While FPS Coert is also on your field: when either of them succeeds at a Quest, both gain 10 MP. Once per turn you may make your opponent reveal their hand.
M.flavourText: Analyzing angles, predicting movements, always one step ahead.

M.name: Ronald, The Mastermind
M.abilityDescription: Master Plan: once per turn, pay 2 Energy: activate a Piecie from your discard pile as if it were ready (this replaces its own Energy cost). It goes back to the discard pile afterwards.
M.flavourText: The greatest artist controls not just the canvas, but reality itself.

M.name: Jisca, The Maestro
M.abilityDescription: Perfect Combo: once per turn, after you activate a Piecie, roll a die: 4–6 activate another ready Piecie of yours for free (no Energy) and one opponent Mosje loses 15 MP; 1–3 Jisca loses 10 MP (ignored if she is at 0 MP).
M.flavourText: Every note is a weapon, every performance a battle.

M.name: Tuk, The Healing Spirit
M.abilityDescription: Healing Hands: once per turn, pay 1 Energy: one of your Mosjes (herself included) gains 20 MP.
M.flavourText: Gentle hands, fierce heart. She mends what others break.

M.name: DJ 80/20, The Lucky Mixer
M.abilityDescription: Lucky Beats: once per turn, reroll any one die (yours or your opponent's).
M.flavourText: The beat drops at exactly the right moment... every time.

M.name: Coert, KasteLuck
M.abilityDescription: Morning Luck: at the start of your turn roll a die: 4–6 draw 1 card and this Mosje gains 5 MP.
M.flavourText: When fortune smiles, she takes full advantage.

M.name: Binti, The Sharp Tongue
M.abilityDescription: Cutting Words: once per turn, pay 1 Energy and discard 1 Piecie from your hand: one opponent Mosje loses 10 MP and the opponent discards 1 card of their choice.
M.synergyEffect: While Coert, The Hawaiian Tech Savant is also on your field: every food Piecie you activate gives its Mosje +10 MP extra.
M.flavourText: Her words cut deeper than any blade.

M.name: [Binti] The Creator
M.abilityDescription: Quick Sketch: Discard 2 FOOD Piecies, then search your deck for any 1 card and add it to your hand.

M.name: Cless, The Teacher
M.abilityDescription: Teaching Moment: when you activate a Piecie, roll a die: 5–6 draw 1 card and one of your Mosjes gains 5 MP.
M.flavourText: When inspiration strikes, magic happens.

M.name: Martin, The Precision Driver
M.abilityDescription: Perfect Line: whenever this Mosje succeeds at a Quest it gains 15 MP extra. Pit Stop: once per turn, pay 1 Energy and discard 2 cards from your hand: draw 3 cards and gain 10 MP.
M.flavourText: Finding the racing line between chaos and control — every millisecond counts.

M.name: [Placeholder 3] The Amplifier
M.abilityDescription: Power Boost: Pay 30 MP — your active Mosje's next ability triggers twice this turn (max 2 uses per game).

M.name: [Coert] Kast-elein
M.abilityDescription: Immovable Object: This Mosje takes 20 less MP loss from every hit, any single 50+ MP hit against it is capped at 25, and it cannot enter the Welloe pile while at 30+ MP.
M.synergyEffect: While Binti the Sharp Tongue is also on your field: your FOOD Piecies give DOUBLE MP.
M.flavourText: Built like a closet — unmovable, unshakeable, unstoppable.

M.name: Tuk "The Builder", The Sims Architect
M.abilityDescription: Perfect Placement: once per turn, pay 1 Energy: look at the top 5 cards of your deck, put 2 in your hand and the rest on the bottom in any order.
M.flavourText: Every piece in its perfect place — just like her dream houses.

M.name: Dancing/DDR Chris
M.abilityDescription: Perfect Combo Chain: whenever you activate a Piecie, roll a die: 5–6 activate another ready Piecie of yours for free (no Energy). Up to 2 times per turn.
M.flavourText: Four arrows, perfect timing, infinite style.

P.name: Mosje Shield

P.name: Leipe Swap
P.description: Swap the MP of one of your Mosjes and one opponent Mosje. A swap is not a gain or a loss: nobody levels up or gets getemt from it.

P.name: Battle Concert

P.description: Look at your opponent's hand and discard 1 card of your choice from it. One of your Mosjes gains 10 MP for each Energy that card costs (max 30). A Binti on your field gains 10 MP more.

P.name: Dingetje toch?!
P.description: Discard this card to count as any card a requirement asks for: a named card, a food / pet / substance / gear Piecie, a Quest cost, or one trait requirement (like "needs Physical ★★"). If the requirement says "ready", this card must be ready. It never adds Quest dice.

P.name: Shhh, popo komt!

P.description: One of your Mosjes gains 15 MP and you draw 1 card. Martin, The Precision Driver on your field: he gains 30 MP instead and you draw 2.

P.name: Perfect Setup
P.description: This turn, one of your Mosjes counts as having any MP from 60 to 90 (you pick) for Quest requirements. Its real MP doesn't change.

P.name: MP Adjuster
P.description: Set active Mosje's MP to any value (20–100). Reverts at start of your next turn.

P.name: Chain Reaction
P.description: This turn, after you activate a Piecie, you may activate one more ready Piecie of yours for free (once).

P.name: Double Trigger
P.description: Both your Mosjes may use their once-per-turn ability one more time this turn (pay the costs again).

P.name: Call of the Welloes
P.description: Stays as long as that Mosje does. Summon a Mosje from your Welloe pile onto a free Mosje spot, at Level 1 with its starting MP (it is fresh). If this card leaves play, the Mosje goes back to the Welloe pile; if the Mosje leaves play, discard this card.

P.name: Welloe Force
P.description: As part of the cost, discard 1 card from your hand. Stays until the start of your next turn. Each time an opponent Mosje attacks one of yours, the attacking Mosje loses 15 MP.

P.name: Kan het?!
P.description: Roll a die for one of your Mosjes: 5–6 it gains 40 MP; 1–4 it loses 10 MP.

P.name: Bowie & Stormey
P.description: Stays until the end of your next turn. One of your Mosjes (choose now) loses 10 less MP each time it loses MP. The named Mosje loses 20 less instead. Named: Gandoe, Michelle, DJ 80/20, Tuk The Healing Spirit or Tuk "The Builder". While Gandoe and Michelle, or Gandoe and a Tuk, are both on your field: both are covered (20 less each), and each gains 10 MP at the start of your next turn.

P.name: Tony
P.description: Stays until the end of your next turn. One of your Mosjes (choose now) loses 10 less MP each time it loses MP. The named Mosje loses 20 less instead. Named: Coert, KasteLuck. While Coert, KasteLuck is also on your field: its Morning Luck works on a 3–6.

P.name: Gekke Vogels
P.description: Stays until the end of your next turn. One of your Mosjes (choose now) loses 10 less MP each time it loses MP. The named Mosje loses 20 less instead. Named: Jisca. While Jisca and an Alyssa are both on your field and KatjeGang is also in play: each of them gains 15 MP at the start of your next turn.

P.name: KatjeGang
P.description: Stays until the end of your next turn. One of your Mosjes (choose now) loses 10 less MP each time it loses MP. The named Mosje loses 20 less instead. Named: an Alyssa. Synergy: Gekke Vogels.

P.description: Roll a die for one of your Mosjes: 1–3 it loses 15 MP; 4–6 it gains 30 MP.
